label: Others are CREATURE_1 from q44 selected essential sources (inference)
rule: Universal instantiation, equality elimination and existential construction
meaning: For each x other than the selected p, participation coverage gives Participated x. Its distinct actual own-being cause c is selected as p, so p causes x. Consequently p causes every other actual being, and each other x is CREATURE_1 with that same p as the universal cause. Creature is instantiated at IsCreatureOfUniversalCause, not CREATURE_2. The own-being source law and numerical source selection are explicit premises; no Fourth-Way universal-cause principle, GOD_4 identification, q3 local-to-common-source shortcut, efficiency, conservation or modal conclusion is used.
